verdict.rationale: Swell documents official Node and PHP API libraries and an official CLI that scaffolds apps (`swell app init`) and pushes them to a development store, so the SDK and scaffolding parts of the story are covered. The evidence never describes an app review, approval, or marketplace distribution path. The only distribution mention concerns themes within storefront apps. missing for 10: documented app review/approval process, app marketplace or distribution path for third-party apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom apps and extensions with official SDKs, scaffolding tooling, and a documented review/distribution path

citations.quote: Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.
swell app init: initialize an app in the current directory with a default config file and folder structure
Swell CLI is a command-line interface that helps you create and work with apps, themes, and storefronts.
swell app push: push configuration files to a development store
